sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of a federal bankruptcy safe harbor. The provision shields certain financial transactions from being unwound by a bankruptcy trustee. The core legal question is whether this protection applies when the funds ultimately reach parties who do not qualify for the shield.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the boundary of financial transaction protections in bankruptcy. It determines whether creditors can recover funds that passed through protected institutions. The outcome affects the stability of financial markets and the rights of bankruptcy estates.
